title: seed twin of the recall-weight-6 fine-tune (rc2s1): two-seed decision rc2 at the E261 point against rc1 / rc1s1

a.recipe: rc2 seed 0 (existing e18_D7_rc2) and seed 1 (new e26_D7_rc2s1: the E219.rc2 command with --seed 1 --name e26_D7_rc2s1, stored distance map LCR_DIST_DIR=$HOME/exp_crn_b123/feats), both at the E261 operating point

c.recipe: rc1 seed 0 / seed 1 at the registered point (recall / recall_s1), re-scored tonight (E265.c)

rule.note: both seeds on the same side; the operating point was chosen on seed 0's VAL frames: seed 1 is the only out-of-sample element (say so in the result)
lead check: Q >= 0.735 on both rc2 seeds; CUT if either rc2 seed < 0.730

referee fix: rise <= 0.030 on both seeds. Lead checks outside decide.py: per-piece DP <= 14.3 and false length <= 0.062 on both seeds; CUT if lanes found a - c < +0.010; INCONCLUSIVE = rc2s2 + rc1s2 in the next GPU window, not adoption

kill: do not start unless E261 PASS; stop if the val250 check at the end of training has Q < 0.725, the total loss exceeds 1.5 x rc2's logged value at the same iteration (rc2: tot 4.0 - 4.1 at 4600 - 4800), or (only if the slot is shared and time is short) the 25 % checkpoint (iteration 1200) is more than 0.01 lanes found below rc1s1 on val250
